title: Algerian Chickpea Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with chickpeas and spices, perfect for a cold winter night.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most international grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped tagine and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, algerian spice blend, and nutty bread crumbs. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, until the flavors have melded together and the liquid has thickened, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
